title: Red Current Chart
obscured_text: The chart is water-soft, but red thread still knots around warm reefs and black vents.
You feel a route trying to remember the hand that drew it.
revealed_text: The voyager marked Erythrocoral shelves as living roads rather than hazards. The crew followed blood-warm currents where ordinary maps ended.
One notation repeats beside every reef: observe before harvesting. The Order did not come only to take.
